messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy started — tag v3.5.2-rc4 -> prod, commit f9a2c1b. Initiated by @Alice Martinez. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary: 5% in us-west2. Release notes: https://short.link/rn-352
Alice Martinez: Kicking off rollout. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.company.com/d/rel/352 — I'll watch p99 and error rate.
Bob Chen: any infra/runtime kernel bump in this push or just model + config?
Claire Ng: model quantization profile updated (q4_0). Pinning legacy path to `model-legacy:v2-quant` for high-memory pool as discussed.
Eng Oncall: I'll be on alerts for the window. Rollback playbook ready (see internal runbook).
deploybot: Canary healthy @5% after 3m, no 5xx spikes, avg p99 change +2ms. Proceeding to 25%.
Dave Patel: noticed a small CPU bump on gpu-pool-2 during canary, latency ok. Flagging but not blocking.
Alice Martinez: agreed — proceed. If errors >0.5% or p99 increases >30% we roll back immediately. @eng-sre FYI.
eng-sre: Investigating a few 500s from reranker-2; looks unrelated (downstream dependency). Will update in 5.
deploybot: Traffic shifted to 25% -> holding 60s for observation.
eng-sre: reranker incident mitigated, 5xx count returned to baseline. No impact on inference service.
Claire Ng: sanity check: local eval on canonical prompts looks good. No new hallucination patterns observed in quick pass.
deploybot: Traffic shift to 60% -> holding 2m. Canary metrics stable.
Dave Patel: observed transient pod OOM on staging worker earlier but prod pools healthy. Noting for postmortem follow-up.
action item (Alice Martinez): post-deploy, run full eval set and open ticket if any regressions.
deploybot: Cutover to 100% complete. Tag v3.5.2-rc4 promoted -> prod at commit f9a2c1b. Rollout duration 18m. Post-rollout metrics snapshot: token throughput +8%, cost/token -2%, p99 latency +4ms.
Bob Chen: confirmed smoke & e2e links — https://ci.company.com/builds/352/smoke (3/3 passed). :thumbsup:
deploybot: Post-deploy checklist executed: smoke tests passed, canary regressions none, rollforward recorded. No rollback initiated.
Claire Ng: I'll schedule the deeper eval later today and post results to the release thread.
Alice Martinez: nice work team, thanks for the fast checks. If anything anomalous pops up ping me. :rocket:
eng-sre: will monitor for 24h and escalate if trends deviate.
Bob Chen: adding release notes link to changelog and tagging repo. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
deploybot: Deployment complete — marking thread closed unless new issues are reported.
